TWILx0001: This Week I Learned: more about how Git commits work, using RAG to improve LLMs, the helpfulness of pilot holes, the pains and rewards of setting up GitHub workflows, and how to consider recipes. To wrap up the week, I learned some basics about US wire colors: green is for ground, white/gray is neutral, and black/red is live. There are other colors, but I didn't need it to help switch over the light switch
